topic: How does real-time beam steering affect network efficiency when managing dynamic traffic in multi-beam satellite systems?
response: Real-time beam steering in multi-beam satellite systems can improve network efficiency by dynamically adjusting beamforming to match changing traffic demands. This reduces interference, increases spectral efficiency, and optimizes resource allocation. The Average Satisfaction Index (ASI) metrics, such as M ASI for Average Used Power, Average Unmet System Capacity, and Average Used Bandwidth, can be used to evaluate the effectiveness of real-time beam steering.
